message.content: On April 3, 2026, the delivery of bread to Li Hua was made by Hailey Johnson. This can be inferred from the content of the message where HaileyJohnson reminds LiHua about the bread delivery and expresses excitement about the freshness of the bread. Specifically, the message reads, "Hey Li Hua! Just a quick reminder that Alice is on her way to deliver your fresh bread this morning. Enjoy! 🥖💖". Here, Alice is identified as the delivery person by HaileyJohnson, though Alice herself confirms the delivery later in the day with a separate message stating, "I am Alice from Hailey's bakery. Your bread has been delivered, please come and pick it up ASAP. Have a good day : )". Thus, the primary delivery person named by HaileyJohnson is Alice.
